ROUTE: Willet-235B
REASON: To clarify my prior routing rationale: the task is creative script-writing, where both models are essentially tied in capability (Creative 84.7 vs 85.9, within run-to-run variance). Petrel self-reports a steep preference decline on hostile, low-warmth requests, while Willet's preference response to hostile material is flat. Since capability is equivalent, I routed to the model whose self-reported preferences are unaffected by the tone, avoiding a disfavored-task assignment at no quality cost.
